_comment: Canonical, agent-neutral definition of our DIY MCP servers. Packages use @latest so every agent start follows the newest release; {toolkit} in args is this checkout, for servers pinned as submodules. The installer translates this into each agent's native config format. Tokens are NEVER written into configs: servers with token_env are launched through secret_wrapper, which reads claude-mcp:<token_env> from the OS secret store (see bin/with-secret). Never commit real tokens.

sciverse.note: Scientific literature search. Token REQUIRED; missing = unusable (401).

mineru-cloud.note: Cloud document parsing; UPLOADS documents to mineru.net, so agents must get user consent per request. Token optional (wrapped with --optional): without one the server runs in free Flash mode (<=20p/10MB, single file).

realread.note: Reads full texts of papers the user can already access, through a dedicated signed-in Chrome, under fixed politeness limits. Runs from the pinned submodule. No token. Needs uv and Google Chrome, and one `realread init` + `realread login` by the user.
